about.title: About Bjørn
about.subtitle: Certified AI Business Professional with 20+ years of experience in digital commerce & marketing.
about.description:
My career is a conscious journey along innovation: from executive roles at tech giants like Sony and Samsung, where I introduced the first Chromebooks in the Netherlands, to building my own craft beer brand. The common thread? Always the question: how can technology make our work truly smarter?

With the rise of AI, everything fell into place. I decided to certify as an AI Business Professional to help organizations not only talk about AI, but actually do it. Whether you are a startup needing an investor-ready plan or an established organization that doesn't want to miss the AI boat: I speak the language of the boardroom and the shop floor. Because I don't believe in technology for technology's sake, but in impact. Let's look together at how we can make your ambitions a reality.

D.title: Determine Objectives
D.question: What is the primary business driver for implementing AI?

efficiency.label: Cost Reduction & Efficiency
efficiency.rec: Focus on automating repetitive tasks with RPA and basic scripting.

growth.label: Revenue Growth & New Markets
growth.rec: Explore AI for product innovation and personalized customer targeting.

cx.label: Customer Experience Improvement
cx.rec: Implement AI-driven chatbots and recommendation engines.

innovation.label: Innovation & Competitive Advantage
innovation.rec: Invest i R&D and cutting-edge generative AI models.

E.title: Establish Success Criteria
E.question: How will you measure the success of this initiative?

roi.label: Quantitative ROI (e.g., hours saved, % growth)
roi.rec: Set up strict financial tracking and ROI dashboards.

qualitative.label: Qualitative Feedback (e.g., employee satisfaction)
qualitative.rec: Conduct regular surveys and feedback loops with staff.

technical.label: Technical Metrics (e.g., model accuracy)
technical.rec: Focus on MLOps and performance monitoring tools.

none.label: We haven't defined KPIs yet
none.rec: Start by defining baseline metrics before scaling.

F.title: Formulate Deliverables
F.question: What is the tangible output you expect currently?

agent.label: A fully autonomous AI agent
agent.rec: Develop a roadmap for agentic workflows.

dashboard.label: A decision support dashboard
dashboard.rec: Build BI dashboards integrated with predictive models.

automation.label: Process automation scripts
automation.rec: Identify high-volume, low-complexity tasks for automation.

strategy.label: Strategic roadmap report
strategy.rec: Engage in strategy workshops to align AI with business goals.

I.title: Identify Stakeholders
I.question: Who is owning the AI budget and decision making?

board.label: C-Level / Board
board.rec: Focus on executive summaries and strategic impact.

it.label: IT / Tech Team
it.rec: Ensure technical feasibility and infrastructure readiness.

distributed.label: Distributed across teams
distributed.rec: Centralize governance to avoid fragmented efforts.

N.title: Navigate Constraints
N.question: What is your biggest constraint right now?

budget.label: Budget / Funding
budget.rec: Start with low-cost, high-impact pilot projects.

data.label: Data Availability / Quality
data.rec: Prioritize data cleaning and infrastructure projects.

skills.label: Internal Skills / Talent
skills.rec: Invest in training or partner with external experts.

legacy.label: Legacy Systems
legacy.rec: Look for potential API wrappers or modernization strategies.

E_risk.title: Evaluate Risks
E_risk.question: How would you rate your organization's risk tolerance for AI?

high.label: High - We innovate fast, break things

moderate.label: Moderate - Fast follower
moderate.rec: Adopt proven technologies shortly after market check.

low.label: Low - Security & Compliance first
low.rec: Focus on private, secure AI deployments and governance.

very_low.label: Very Low - Skeptical
very_low.rec: Start with non-critical, internal-facing pilot projects.

F_frame.title: Feasibility Study
F_frame.question: Is there any idea on a potential solution yet?

theory.label: Theoretical assessment only
theory.rec: Launch a rapid PoC to check assumptions.

R.title: Roadmap Creation
R.question: What is your desired timeline for implementation?

sprint.label: 1-3 Months (Sprint)
sprint.rec: Plan for an agile sprint delivery.

project.label: 3-6 Months (Project)
project.rec: Structure as a formal project with milestones.

A.title: AI Implementation
A.question: Do you prefer a Build or Buy strategy?

hybrid.label: Hybrid (API integration)
hybrid.rec: Integrate powerful APIs into custom workflows.

lowcode.label: Low-code / No-code
lowcode.rec: Empower business users with low-code tools.

M.title: Measurement
M.question: Do you have existing data pipelines to measure performance?

modern.label: Yes, modern data warehouse
modern.rec: Leverage existing data for real-time AI insights.

fragmented.label: Yes, but fragmented
fragmented.rec: Consolidate data sources for better model training.

scale.label: Scale to other departments
scale.rec: Create a Center of Excellence for scaling.

depth.label: Deepen capability in one area
depth.rec: Specialize and refine the model further.

maintain.label: Maintain and optimize
maintain.rec: Focus on operational stability and cost optimization.
